Learn moreSign in Comments 42 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Val Kilmer, ‘Top Gun' and ‘Batman' star, dies at 65 523Likes15,619ViewsApr 22025 Val Kilmer, the brooding, versatile actor who played fan favorite Iceman in “Top Gun,” donned a voluminous cape as Batman in “Batman Forever” and portrayed Jim Morrison in “The Doors,” has died. He was 65.⁠ ⁠ Kilmer died Tuesday night in Los Angeles, surrounded by family and friends, his daughter said in an email to The Associated Press.
